# scripts/Interaction/Inventory.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/Inventory.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Player inventory data: purse total, key IDs, counted belt entries, selection.
HandSlot renders the selected entry; -1 selects empty hands.
Mutation signals are synchronous and selected_item() returns the stored dictionary.

Base: `Node`. Registered class: `none`.

### take_one

```gdscript
func take_one(id: StringName) -> void
```

[Source:116](../../../../../scripts/Interaction/Inventory.gd#L116)

Consumes one matching item; at zero count removes it and clears matching selection.
Missing IDs are a no-op; removing an earlier item shifts belt_index.

| Parameter | Type in source | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `StringName` | required |

Return type: `void`.
